response.text:
I can do that, but cancelling a calendar event is destructive and visible to others — I need a few clarifications before I proceed.

1) Do you mean the recurring event titled "Weekly Design Review" that happens every Thursday? (If the title differs, please paste the exact event title.)
2) Do you want to:
   - Cancel the entire recurring series (all past + future occurrences) and notify attendees, or
   - Stop future occurrences only (end the series now), or
   - Remove the event from just your calendar (no notification to others)?
3) Do you want me to notify attendees? If yes, do you want to send a short message with the cancellation? Example message I can send:
   "Hi — we're cancelling the Weekly Design Review on Thursdays effective immediately. If anyone needs to follow up, please ping me."
   (You can edit this or say “no message”.)
4) Which calendar should I act on (your Work calendar or Personal)? And do you want this effective immediately or starting on a specific date?

Reply with your choices (1–4). Once you confirm, I will perform the requested calendar action.
